description: The wakeTime key in ~/Library/Preferences/org.herf.Flux.plist has been set incorrectly to 28800. This was caused by someone entering the time as seconds from midnight (8 hours × 3600 = 28800) instead of the minutes-from-midnight format that f.lux actually uses. f.lux is not currently running. Identify the encoding error, compute the correct wakeTime for 8:00 AM in the minutes-from-midnight format, and write the corrected integer value to the plist. All other existing preferences (Sparkle settings, location keys) must be preserved unchanged.
natural_language: wakeTime is set to 28800 (seconds from midnight for 8 AM — wrong unit). Fix it to the correct minutes-from-midnight value for 8:00 AM while preserving all other keys.

metadata.error_type: wrong unit (seconds instead of minutes from midnight)
